create_custom_error: create a CustomError exception with a message, HTTP status code, and error code for API responses
raise_cacheable_error: raise a CacheableError subclass like DatasetNotFoundError or ConfigNotFoundError with an optional cause exception
convert_error_to_response: call as_response on a CustomError to get a JSON-serializable error dict with optional cause details
handle_dataset_not_found: raise DatasetNotFoundError when a requested dataset does not exist on the HuggingFace Hub
handle_split_not_found: raise SplitNotFoundError when a requested dataset split does not exist
